subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should the supported agent-facing usage contract extend `session_status.details`, or should OpenClaw add a separate read-only usage tool?
rationale: Source proves the capability is missing and reusable data exists, but repository evidence cannot decide the permanent public tool boundary, which data classes agents may see, or the required freshness semantics.

options.title: Extend session_status details
options.body: Keep one status entry point and add stable structured session, last-turn, cost, and quota fields while preserving existing text output and visibility checks.

options.title: Add a dedicated usage tool
options.body: Keep `session_status` lightweight and expose a separate visibility-safe query tool backed by the shared usage aggregation layer.

options.title: Limit to session tokens first
options.body: Ship only session and last-turn token/cost data now and defer provider quota windows until their availability and freshness contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Extend session_status details
recommendation.body: Keep one status entry point and add stable structured session, last-turn, cost, and quota fields while preserving existing text output and visibility checks.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history spans both the agent status return path and the structured gateway usage implementation needed for this API choice.
